[Precision Manufacturing Group | FY2024 | Note 1 - Long-Term Manufacturing Contracts and Revenue]

Note 1: Long-Term Manufacturing Contracts and Revenue
Precision Manufacturing Group applies IFRS 15 for heavy machinery build contracts. Revenue is recognized over time using the input cost-to-cost percentage-of-completion method. Contract assets of EUR 14.2 million represent unbilled work in progress under long-cycle industrial fabrication agreements.

[Precision Manufacturing Group | FY2024 | Note 3 - Defined Benefit Pension Liabilities]

Note 3: Defined Benefit Pension Liabilities
The Group operates a defined benefit pension scheme covering European factory personnel. The present value of funded obligations was EUR 42.0 million against plan assets of EUR 39.2 million, resulting in a net recognized deficit of EUR 2.8 million.
